column1: # Storm Proof AI kit manifest (sizes as of Nov 7, 2026). Tab separated:
# --- library: offline Wikipedia, medicine, repair and survival (Kiwix, CC BY-SA and others)
# --- maps: whole-world street map (Protomaps daily build, OpenStreetMap ODbL)
# --- search: US + Canada address search (Photon, GraphHopper build of OSM data)
# --- routing: US + Canada turn-by-turn directions (Valhalla builds ~23 GB of road tiles from these on first start)
# --- ai: the everyday models (medical, general without refusals, and a small fast one)
# --- ai-big: the 120B model (needs a 128 GB machine)
